finding: Linux restricted seccomp denies connect. Managed proxy routing permits AF_UNIX only with allow-all Unix sockets; per-path Unix-socket proxy allowlists are macOS-specific. Corrected profile retains workspace filesystem and never, with proxy domain policy and all local AF_UNIX access. No global config mutation. Probe results are scoped to the tested operations, not a universal isolation proof.

shared_server_failure.detail: Earlier inference that shared-server reuse alone explained fallback was disproved: --no-daemon also selected :workspace. Actual F2 startup warning established /etc/codex/requirements.toml disallowed the requested named profile. Source behavior and isolated sandbox success do not establish real-session policy acceptance.

managed_requirements.required_setup: Explicit user-approved sudo addition of frontierplan-herdr=true in allowed_permission_profiles; proposal prepared, approval pending.
